title: Anna Blue | KEY.co
description_expanded: Set within the desirable Crossing District of WaterColor, this stunning three-level retreat blends refined coastal style with spacious comfort designed for memorable group getaways. Thoughtfully designed with five bedrooms and five-and-a-half bathrooms, the home welcomes with warm wood flooring, a beautifully styled living area, and a chef-inspired kitchen ideal for everything from relaxed breakfasts to elegant evening gatherings. A private king suite on the main level offers a peaceful escape, while the second floor features two additional king suites and a luxurious primary suite with a private balcony overlooking the pool—perfect for quiet mornings or sunset relaxation.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
